Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614031. Join activities to assays on assay_id and to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1614031, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
